image_prompt.text: Dense clusters of hiding props spread across the arena floor to break sightlines: 15-20 warm brown crates and boxes in clusters stacked two to three high, 8-12 large gray stone pillars and columns, and 10-15 green spherical bushes, gray rocks and planters
A maze-like warren of small rooms and corridors built from 10-15 low muted blue-gray partition walls, forming narrow passages, open pockets and plenty of blind corners to hide and be hunted in

A multi-level stone-gray central tower at the heart of the arena that players go inside and climb, with open doorways off the floor, internal stairs and enclosed upper levels to hide on - the focal point of the map
Tall boundary walls about 30 studs high enclosing the roughly rectangular 200x200 stud arena floor so players cannot escape
Ramps, stairs and raised wood-brown platforms at several different heights for vertical hiding and movement

notes: Preset Childhood Game taken on its own shape (space-continuous); its social-hub option was dropped because the prompt specifies one fully enclosed arena and enumerates its contents, with no lobby or between-rounds gathering space anywhere in it.
P6 comes from obstacle-maze: the partition-wall warren has to be a valid, navigable set of passages and blind corners by construction.

P3 comes from building-interior, promoted from the prompt's central structure - players climb and hide inside it through open doorways, so it is a genuine outside-to-inside transition rather than a facade. Flagged because P3 is not on the proven pipeline yet; if it has to wait, the tower can ship as an open climbable structure on P0 instead.

Counts were left out of the picks because every quantity in the prompt is a range or an open-ended floor (15-20 crates, 8-12 pillars, 10-15 wall segments, 10-15 foliage elements, 50+ objects overall) rather than a single stated number; the figures are carried in the option text so nothing is lost.
Non-geometry requests the layout handoff cannot carry: low-poly art style with flat colors, and the configurable attributes ArenaSize, WallHeight and ObjectDensity.

would have asked: 'Sounds like a classic hide-and-seek arena - one continuous enclosed play space, dense clutter clusters of crates, pillars and bushes to break sightlines, and a maze of low partition walls making corridors and blind corners, plus the multi-level central tower you can climb and hide inside. Want that as-is?'
would have asked: whether they want a lobby or staging area for players to gather in between rounds - the preset includes one but the prompt describes only the sealed arena, so it was left out.
would have asked: whether round start points should be spread evenly around the arena, since hide-and-seek needs somewhere to spawn but the prompt never says where.
would have asked: 'Anything else you want in the space?'
